introduction.section1: While Paris is inevitably the first city that comes to mind, France has so much more to discover. Cities full of history with museums and majestic castles. Small perched villages in the South and sunny beaches, or simple hikes to discover superb remote corners... France is also famous for its gastronomy, taste French specialties while savoring a good wine.
introduction.section2: Let us take you through our articles and photos on our journey through metropolitan France, region by region.
